title: Preview: China trade data due today, a beat could firm up AUD as a demand proxy trade
description: A stronger-than-forecast export print would extend China's reliance on external demand to offset a sluggish domestic economy, a dynamic that has held even as it pushes trade tensions with major partners further into focus. Import strength, if it also beats forecast, would be read more constructively as a signal of firmer domestic demand rather than just re-exported components, and tends to carry more weight for commodity-linked currencies including the Australian dollar.
